chunks: Tell them: 'Nothing can befall us except what God decrees. Our protector is He, and in God should the faithful place their trust.'
ai.seo_question: What does it mean for believers to place their trust in God according to divine decree?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm the concept of *al-husn al-dhann* (good opinion of God), linking divine decree (*qadr*) with active reliance (*tawakkul*) rather than passive fatalism. It underscores that God is the ultimate *Mawla* (guardian/leader) of the believers, a title that resonates with the Imamate's role as the manifestation of divine authority on earth. Consequently, the faithful are instructed to anchor their spiritual stability in this divine guardianship during times of trial.
